main.description: Returns the earliest indexed follow record for one actor-to-actor relationship, or null when no matching relationship is indexed. Authentication is not required and the response is not personalized.

actor.description: DID of the actor who published the follow record. Required.

subject.description: DID of the actor named as the follow record's subject. Required.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A required DID is invalid, repeated, or accompanied by an unknown parameter.

followRecordView.description: Raw indexed follow record view, including the DID that published the relationship.

actorFollowView.description: The displayed actor and the raw follow record representing its relationship.

output.description: The raw representative follow record, or explicit null when the relationship is not indexed.

follow.description: The earliest-created indexed record for the actor and subject pair, with URI and publisher metadata.
